headline: Rio Tinto Announces Third Lithium Plant and Expands into Copper
summary: Rio Tinto announced plans for a third lithium plant and is expanding its operations into the copper market during executive visits to mining regions.
why: Diversification into critical energy transition minerals like lithium and copper positions major mining conglomerates to capture future demand driven by electrification.

impacts.name: Mining & Metals
impacts.why: Expansion into high-demand transition metals like lithium and copper strengthens long-term growth prospects for major miners.
